rationale: C04 is an aggregate equity-share coverage flag, so this is Class 3. The raw schedule header includes Principal/Shares, and multiple Equity Interest source rows carry non-empty values in that column, including BTX Precision with 1 share, BCPC Project Aberdeen with 774 shares, and Bain Capital Senior Loan Program II with 2,250 shares. The extracted metric says 0.0% of 34 equity rows have shares, so the source supports a real extraction gap rather than a false alarm.
